blocks.text: This report describes the Shaddad robot as it really is: the **XMachines MAX** tracked platform used by NASL, with its sprayer module, battery, traction drive and electronics. For each component it sets the real part and its specification next to the way the component is represented in the `Shaddad_UGV` MATLAB/Simulink/Simscape digital twin. It also explains the model-based design (MBD) method: one parameter source drives generated models, and tests check every change.

The model was re-parameterised to the real robot on 27 October 2026 from the data received that day: the dimension and weight sheet of the platform, the traction-motor nameplate, the battery specification sheet and battery-box drawing, and photos of the sprayer pump and the electronics. Before that date the model used design estimates for a generic tracked carrier.
